Enemies now flash white for 0.2s when `hit()` is called, using `res://shaders/flash.gdshader` on each enemy's `Sprite2D`; the change is in `scripts/enemy.gd` and `scenes/enemy.tscn`. The review reports no errors, but I couldn't run the game.

Each enemy duplicates its material in `_ready()`, so only the hit enemy flashes. The flash starts before the kill check, but an enemy killed by the hit is freed the same frame, so its flash won't be visible on a killing blow.
